subject: Crescent Biotech — Penetration test report access and redaction guidance
messages:
From: Maya Singh <maya.singh@crescentbio.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: security@crescentbio.com
Date: 2026-05-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: latest penetration test report (urgent)

Hi Neha,

Following the notice from one of our vendors over the weekend, our security team is doing an accelerated review of all third-party security attestations. Can you please provide the most recent penetration test report you have for Redwood Inference (including scope and any remediation notes)?

We need to review the findings and confirm whether there are any overlapping IOCs or exposures that affect our environment. If possible, we also need guidance on whether you can provide a redacted version suitable for distribution to our InfoSec steering committee.

Requested turnaround: 48 hours if possible — we understand this is short notice. If there are legal or export constraints, please let us know.

Thanks,
Maya Singh
Head of Information Security
Crescent Biotech

(attachment: crescent_request_20260509.msg)
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Maya Singh <maya.singh@crescentbio.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-09T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: latest penetration test report (urgent)

Maya — thanks for the heads up and sorry to hear about the vendor incident.

We can share our latest external penetration test report, but we have a short internal process for redaction to protect certain internal IP and PII discovered during testing. Quick notes:
- We can provide an executive redacted PDF for distribution (high-level findings, severity, remediation status).
- We can also provide the full report under an NDA and additional controls (secure transfer) if Crescent needs deep technical detail.

Could you confirm whether the steering committee needs the unredacted technical detail or an executive summary will suffice? Also confirm the email addresses for any additional recipients and whether you have an existing NDA on file.

I’ve looped in Marissa (security) and Dev (engineering) to coordinate redaction and remediation status. We’ll prioritize this.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive — Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

(attachment: unredacted_pen_test_report_v1.2.pdf)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-10T08:16:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Deliverable: Pen Test report for Redwood Inference (v1.2)

Thanks Tom — and Neha, Maya. I pulled the report and did an initial read. High level guidance for sharing externally:

1) Redaction scope: remove explicit internal hostnames, IP addresses, and any raw user PII. Keep high-level vulnerability titles, severity, and remediation status.
2) Executive summary: 1–2 pages summarizing scope, dates, top 5 findings, and remediation % complete. We'll attach remediation tracking for each finding.
3) IOCs: we can provide indicators that are generic (CVE IDs, exploited vectors) but will avoid tying to internal ephemeral hostnames unless Crescent's team requests IoC correlation under NDA.

Action items (for us):
- Dev: confirm which findings are fully remediated and provide patch/timestamp evidence. (See pen_test_scope_matrix.csv attached.)
- Neha: prepare a redacted PDF and an executive summary to send to Crescent.

I will review the redacted draft before it goes out. If Crescent asks for deeper technical telemetry (full logs/PoCs), we will require an NDA and an agreed secure transfer method.

Marissa Cole
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

(attachment: pen_test_scope_matrix.csv)
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-11T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pen Test report remediation status

Quick status update on the top findings called out in the report:

- FINDING 3 (High): Auth bypass in service gateway — remediation deployed 2026-05-10T02:34:00Z (patch in prod, can provide CVE mapping: CVE-2025-3145).
- FINDING 7 (Medium): Insecure S3 ACL on internal logs bucket — corrected 2026-05-10T04:12:00Z, bucket now private, versioning enabled.
- FINDING 12 (Low): Informational disclosure via debug header — toggled off in prod 2026-05-09T21:00:00Z.

I’ve compiled the evidence (links to changelogs and deployment IDs) in the summary file attached. Let me know if you want full logs; those will require an NDA and limited-access repo.

Dev Patel
Senior Software Engineer, Infra
Redwood Inference

(attachment: response_summary.md)
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Maya Singh <maya.singh@crescentbio.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-12T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Deliverable: Redacted pen test report + executive summary

Hi Maya — thanks for the patience. Attached is the redacted PDF suitable for distribution to your steering committee, plus a one-page executive summary and our remediation tracker. Per Marissa’s guidance we removed internal hostnames and PII; the attached redaction log documents exactly which sections were redacted.

Files included:
- redacted_pen_test_report_v1.2.pdf (redacted for external share)
- response_summary.md (remediation mapping and timestamps)
- pen_test_scope_matrix.csv (scope + environment mapping)

If your team needs IoC correlation (e.g., specific IPs or PoCs) we can provide those under NDA and a secure transfer. We can also schedule a short call between Marissa/Dev and your security team if you want to walk through the findings.

Next steps suggested:
1) Confirm receipt and whether the exec summary suffices for the steering committee.
2) If deeper details are requested, confirm NDA and recipient list.
3) If Crescent wants a joint call, propose 30-minute windows on Tue/Wed next week.

Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive — Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

(attachments: redacted_pen_test_report_v1.2.pdf, response_summary.md, pen_test_scope_matrix.csv)
